title: Coi-Zhi/Space-Growing-A-Multi-Step-Neural-Framework-for-3D-Architectural-Completion
summary: 该开源项目利用体素网格作为基本的空间语法，结合Transformer架构的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，通过两个阶段迭代生成3D建筑结构：'Bridge'阶段和'Grow'阶段，实现了高效的3D建筑完成模型。
description: utilizing voxel grids as a fundamental spatial syntax,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system driven by a Transformer architecture. The model generates structures iteratively through two distinct stages: a "Bridge" phase,and a "Grow" phase.
